comment: At least one identifier is required, including the UUID slice with system fixed to be-ns-diagnostic-report-diabetes. Slicing is open, so other business identifiers can be added.

source_description: Date of the last update of the report
From date to date corresponding to the period covered by the report. Typically 14 to 30 days. See business rules
comment: effective[x] is restricted to Period; start and end are both mandatory.

source_description: The patient that this report is about
target_description: The subject of the report - usually, but not always, the patient
comment: Reference(BePatient). For GDPR reasons, sensor suppliers may not use the NISS of their users in external communication.

source_description: Report status, by default “Final”. The value is assigned according to the business rule on “% Data Captured”
comment: Bound to BeVSDiabetesReportStatus. The value is assigned according to the business rule on % Data Captured.

source_description: The healthcare professional (INAMI number / national register number) or organization (INAMI approval number / company number) that encodes the information and takes responsibility for its content
comment: Reference(BePractitioner | BeOrganization). The professional is identified by INAMI or national register number, the organization by INAMI approval or company number.

source_description: Healthcare provider (INAMI number / national register number) who added an interpretation to the report (e.g. endocrinologist, general practitioner). Not provided by the producer of the report
comment: Reference(BePractitionerRole | BePractitioner). Not provided by the report producer; added by the interpreting care provider.

source_description: Category of the report. At least one category must be assigned

Identification number assigned by INAMI to the type of sensor model used to create the observations on which the report is based. The individual sensor device is mentioned in the measurement observation
comment: valueCodeableConcept bound (extensible) to BeVSDiabetesDeviceType. The individual sensor device is mentioned in the measurement observation.

source_description: Report code - indicating the type of procedure that leads to the production of the primary values of this report, i.e. 439926003 | Ambulatory continuous glucose monitoring of interstitial tissue fluid
comment: Bound to BeVSDiabetesReportCode (e.g. 439926003 Ambulatory continuous glucose monitoring of interstitial tissue fluid).

source_description: List of references to “derived values” type observations (a dozen derived observations) mentioned in the report. These observations are part of the diagnostic report
References to the measured diabetes observations (a few thousand measurements) used to produce the analysis
comment: Reference(BeObservationDiabetes). Shares DiagnosticReport.result with the derived observations; there is no separate slice yet.

source_description: Report comments in free text format. Not provided by the producer of the report, but by the healthcare provider doing the interpretation
comment: Not provided by the report producer; added by the interpreting care provider.

source_description: PDF document containing the complete report (text, graphics, deduced observations, conclusions, etc.)
